description.value: Gold Train Express is a Vietnamese restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver offering an extensive menu of pho, rice dishes, banh mi, spring rolls, and Vietnamese drinks. It has built a loyal local following over the years, with 28 reviews consistently praising the pho broth and lemongrass chicken. Online ordering with fast pickup makes it a practical meal stop for cyclists passing through this busy corridor.
